title: Ionized neon made by hand at Node Gamma from the trader's own stored neon gas, docked, no jump
note: 2026-11-22 19:46 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-065, block MERCURY (every trader operating at the least fuel per XP) and P1 (train at the least fuel per XP), rule F8 (docked zero-fuel crafting before jump loops) and F23 (every ship crafts its own stores). Traders store 1,570 (4 traders) of neon gas here (table holdings, 2026-11-22 19:44 UTC); its bids at home are none or thin (sellgen.py scan 19:42 UTC) and none of it is reserved (pull.py levels 19:37 UTC: ionized_neon is no good of the reserve, so the pull rule does not close this route). 6 neon gas into 3 ionized neon (an input of synthesize_neon_power_cell for the reserve's power cells, of air recyclers and sensor boosters) (by hand, 0 cr). A trader docked here trains Crafting with no jump and no fuel, in place of the jump loop (train-jumps-trader, -540 cr a ship-hour in 12 hours; docked crafts measured 1,400 to 2,000 XP a ship-hour, fleet view=xp 19:27 UTC). The craft list asks the recipe in halving sizes (128 down to 1, as craft-nitrogen-own-*): a size the stores cannot fill makes nothing and the next is asked. The list then asks extract_xenon (6 xenon gas into 3 purified xenon) in the same sizes, for the xenon some of these traders store here. Nothing is bought or sold; the output stays in the pilot's storage. Standing work; closes by itself under 60 neon gas stored here. A test: three results decide (F37); max_ships 3, the traders that hold the gas here.
